value.rationale: The skew Schäffer infimum was recently defined, but its sharp value alone hides extremizer geometry. This provides a complete equality description on any real L4 and an optimal quantitative fourth-power stability modulus for all skew parameters, with a clear boundary at classical tau=1. These are natural structural and stability questions for the invariant rather than a reparameterized value or arbitrary test case.
